assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only shokugeki-no-soma:hayama-akira@manga#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional V2 bounded character model SHOKUGEKI_HAYAMA_CHARACTER_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese manga V01-V36 including Le dessert. Its linked deep readings (D06-D36), state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, evidence matrix and validation audits are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The project's readiness label substantial and its authority_state are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Five model states from the child research pupil through the confident Election specialist, the Central bargain and provisional Ninth Seat, the V22-V23 bear defeat and immediate aftermath, to the later peer and adult academic trajectory. The evidence is located by volume reading key (D06, D08, D10, D12, D13, D21, D22, D23, D36), not by page or scene; Election and Central states are the most detailed, and the post-correction, Jun-repair and adult states are compressed. The serialized ending and the three Le dessert tiers are kept distinct by the model but not itemized for Hayama.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A governing thesis (nose becomes authorship through research, cultivation and a person he wants to reach; gratitude turned into a debt that authorizes self-sacrifice against the beneficiary's wishes) with rejected readings (magical nose, one-note rival, simple traitor, helpless captive) and an eight-row trigger-state-recipient table labeled H/M/U. It predicts an overreach, sacrificial protection that overrides Jun's refusal under Central. It does not decide how ambition, protection of Jun's research and Jun's stated wishes trade off in a new choice: the model holds that those motives 'can be true together', and its own probe of the decisive post-correction choice (Jun offers to rebuild without his accepting an unwanted post) ends 'exact compliance or conflict is unshown'. That is insufficiency on the deciding motive, not productive uncertainty about wording.

Five named states each carry an available pattern and a limit, and the default state when time is unspecified is fixed (the post-Central correction as the latest detailed relational state). Transitions are tied to volume keys (D13 Election, D21-D22 Central, D22-D23 bear defeat, D36 adult). The states are coarse, the post-correction and adult states are explicitly compressed, and durable Jun repair and research recovery are named material gaps.

Register is described as measured, clipped and technically certain, with recipient conditioning (formal professor address to Jun alongside blunt practical commands; distant and accusatory toward Soma in the Central state; compact later thanks) and explicit prohibitions (invented dialect, automatic spice metaphors, mechanically emotionless delivery). No Japanese form is quoted, the model says the voice ledger warrants recipient-conditioned address more strongly than a first-person inventory, and manga text gives no acoustic delivery. The description is substantial but not an operational voice model.

Ordinary evidence is research and greenhouse work, cooking and blunt practical caretaking around Jun's flustered habits, keyed to D06 with the adult teaching destination at D36. The model forbids inventing a domestic chore list, favorite cuisine or taste ranking and states that its narrow ordinary sample is not proof he has no life outside research. Bounded canon questions only.

A matched-recipient rule holds one statement ('You need to change what you are doing') constant across Jun (guardian, scholarly authority and someone he cares for, whose objection to the Central bargain is not a technical suggestion) and Soma (rival and answering eater, no filial-debt frame), with shorter modifiers for Ryo, Erina or Central officials and an unknown colleague. Jun's canonical refusal is located (D22-D23); the model states it lacks a pattern of Hayama accepting ordinary refusal from other recipients and leaves the later Jun relationship open.

Emotion-to-action routes are stated (pride as precise certainty, protective fear as institutional choice, shame and isolation when the chosen purpose stops answering the person invoked, compact gratitude) and the model warns that quietness is not absence of feeling. These are inferences from depicted behavior without located interior access, and the model says the complete emotional range outside craft and the guardian relation is a material gap.

Competitive conflict is conditioned and located: clipped confidence and demonstration when Soma exposes a gap (D08, D21), acceptance of the Central bargain when Jun's research is threatened (D21-D22), tasting, confronting the difference and thanking after the 1-2 bear loss (D22-D23). A typed failure list separates technical insufficiency, an unresponsive purpose, coerced institutional choice and ordinary irritation. Response to a recurrence of the Central threat after correction is stated as untested, and nonculinary conflict is not sampled.

The ethical content is one located decision under constraint (the Central bargain), its rejection by the beneficiary, and the model's negative control against any debt owed by a raised child that overrides refusal. The model shows the error and the correction, not a deliberation procedure, and its post-correction probe abstains. Substantial interpretation without an operational account.
The model records no Hayama humor or play repertoire beyond blunt caretaking around Jun's habits. This gap says nothing about the character's actual humor.

The model consolidates a complete V2 original-Japanese sequential reading through analytical retrieval and keys claims to nine volume readings, but it carries no archive-image locators for Hayama-specific claims, no evidence matrix rows of its own, and lists four material gaps (Jun repair and research recovery, nonculinary life, adult dishes, emotional range outside craft). The 127-line consolidation is compact relative to his V06-V23 role.

Affirmative canonical limitations are located: the 1-2 bear defeat (D22-D23), Jun's refusal of the sacrificial bargain (D22-D23), separate expulsion consequences, and Hayama's later joint-runner-up rivals. Negative controls reject smell-as-mind-reading, debt-overrides-refusal, romance inferred from Jun care, pure victim or traitor, academic title as universal competence and complete repair from one thank-you. All rest on one secondary artifact.

A default state is fixed, the state table separates Election, Central, defeat and adult periods, and the model forbids transferring a rule across periods without reading the state table. Locators are volume-level only and the later states are compressed, so the rule selects a period rather than giving fine chronology.

scenario_readiness.note: No Japanese form is quoted, the model describes register only qualitatively, and it states that manga text does not establish acoustic delivery. Generated lines would rest on description rather than attested forms and would not be constrained enough even for illustrative use. This bounds the evidence set, not Hayama's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named model state, defaulting to the post-Central correction; the Central bargain state is used only when explicitly selected, and no adult domestic or managerial state is used.
The situation is a concrete culinary comparison, spice or aroma diagnosis, or research-continuity problem where the model's H rules apply.
The interlocutor is Jun, Soma, Ryo, Erina or a Central official in a named state; an unknown colleague is handled at M in task-only mode without invented history.
A new choice that pits protection of Jun's work against her stated wishes or his ambition is output as an open fork, not a prediction.
Output is behavioral description with the model's H, M or U label, not quoted canon dialogue.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named model state, defaulting to the post-Central correction after the D22-D23 bear defeat; the Election and Central states only when explicitly selected.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Jun as guardian, scholarly authority and someone he cares for; Soma as rival and answering eater; Ryo as a serious specialist rival; Erina or Central officials as title-holders; an unknown colleague at M in task-only mode.
setting_constraints: Culinary research, greenhouse, kitchen or contest setting
A concrete aroma, spice or composition problem, or a threat to the continuity of Jun's research
No adult administration, classroom management or domestic routine
Unshown Jun-repair and post-correction sacrifice choices end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model works three noncanonical probes with H, M and U outcomes and abstains on its declared surfaces. Readiness is conditional because only culinary comparison and Jun-related protection have located rules, and the decisive post-correction Jun choice is unshown.
Ordinary texture is one D06 cluster of research work and blunt caretaking around Jun. The model forbids inventing domestic routine and abstains from precise adult domestic routines.

The evidence establishes one located constrained decision and its rejection by the beneficiary. The model's probe of the same dilemma after correction ends 'exact compliance or conflict is unshown'. A new deliberation cannot be run on this evidence set.
The model's negative controls forbid converting reciprocity or Jun caretaking into romance and abstain from unseen romantic commitments. The evidence establishes no romantic relationship.

conditions: Student-era culinary contests, research and Central-era assignments only, using the Election, burger and bear dishes as the located examples of authored aromatic systems.
Technical judgment is specific and sensory but does not decide finished dishes or interpersonal truths by smell alone.
No teaching policy, research administration or adult managerial conduct is invented; the model marks that surface U.
scenario_readiness.note: His student culinary work is the best-located part of the model; adult academic work is a destination without a management model.

known_limits.statement: The model's probe of Jun rebuilding a lab without his accepting an unwanted post states that considering rebuilding together is plausible but exact compliance or conflict is unshown; the decisive trade-off among ambition, protection and Jun's wishes after the correction is not established.
Durable Jun repair, research recovery, detailed adult dishes and daily adult conduct are named material gaps; the later state is compressed and must not be filled from one thank-you.
Caretaking does not establish romance, and gratitude toward the person who raised him does not establish a debt that overrides her refusal.
The 1-2 bear loss, the separate expulsion consequence and relational repair are distinct outcomes; the loss does not make him a failed cook.

The evidence is one compact active_provisional consolidation keyed to volume readings only. Its linked deep readings, ledgers, evidence matrix and fidelity audit are not curated on this subject, so its warrants were not rechecked here; no held-out validation is part of this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
